status: CALCULATED SENSITIVITY; NO PLACED OR ROUTED PCB REVIEW
leakage_assumptions: Steady state; input coupling capacitor open; VMID held at 1.5 V; an added ohmic path from preamp + input to GND; no bias current or amplifier offset. This is surface leakage sensitivity, not a measured capacitor-insulation result.
feedback_assumptions: One capacitance directly across total 1.818 MOhm feedback resistance. Values describe only its impedance, not complete filter gain, stability, distributed pad capacitance or CMRR.

common_return_example.qualification: Illustrative V=IZ. Only a portion may convert to differential error; actual current path, frequency-dependent impedance and rejection require geometry/measurement.

candidate_crosstalk_review_check.status: PROPOSED REVIEW CHECK; NOT USER-ACCEPTED REQUIREMENT
candidate_crosstalk_review_check.rationale: A 1 uVpp sine is 0.354 uVrms, small compared with the existing 3.44 uVrms calculated electronics-noise result. Coherent, broadband and multiple-aggressor cases need an aggregate criterion.
candidate_crosstalk_review_check.qualification: Compute input equivalence using victim gain at the same frequency and source configuration, not a fixed 1 kHz gain.
